notes.title: Discover What’s New in Goblin Journal Demo #2
notes.content:
Greetings, archivists and adventurers!
The second Goblin Journal demo is here, now featuring a full tutorial! A dedicated level guides you through the goblins’ adventures and reveals the secrets of their journals through the translator’s story. It’s a perfect introduction for new players and a chance for veterans to explore the improvements we’ve made.


A complete tutorial level with its own story


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594843/305e0f824b7ace82efe787f2b0a2ba84f8dde225.gif"]


Also new in this demo
Updated tooltips for items, abilities, and statuses.

Showing the squad members who survived the combat.

Enemy intention system updates and new combat animations (hit, blood, death).

Initiative calculation with a d6 roll, action point costs, and turn order indicators.

Visual enhancements: shadows for combatants, fort building labels, placeholders for empty arena positions, and dimming inactive combatants.

Squad panel layout and background improvements.
New features and quality-of-life updates
Reworked some orders (action, target, buff)

Added rest punishment (pursuers advance)

One sleep per fort visit

Combatant death animation

Equipment now respects HP, preventing accidental losses

New items, including tools to knock back pursuers on the map
Fixes
Fixed food display over “zzz” on the map

Fixed selling duplicate instances in fort

Fixed saving bag after removing or equipping items

Fixed position status application

Fixed armor locking in combat

Saved fort item and hire pool state between visits

Fixed goblins spawning with 0 HP

Fixed stun, haste, and hold status behavior

Fixed random initiative recalculation at round start in some cases

Fixed equipping armor during events so it’s not lost from inventory
Localization
We’re also excited to announce that Goblin Journal will be localized into several languages this September, including Russian, French, German, and Spanish.
[hr][/hr]
Why your feedback matters: Every suggestion helps us make the game sharper, more immersive, and funnier in all the right ways. 

What’s next: Expanded journals, item synergy, advanced enemies, and much more await in the full version. Download the demo, explore the tutorial, and share your discoveries on Steam or Discord!

— The Goblin Journal dev team

notes.title: Demo Launch Announcement — Goblin Journal
notes.content:
Greetings, archivists and adventurers!
The first playable slice of Goblin Journal has just landed on Steam, letting you translate one complete journal (three procedural maps) and lead a scrappy squad of goblins through tactical turn-based battles — all while uncovering the mystery behind an ancient, rune-sealed box.
[hr][/hr]What’s inside the demo?
🗺️ 3 handcrafted levels built from our procedural map system (forest cliffs, river chapel, storm-torn pass).

⚔️ Mandatory intro battles on each map + plenty of random events in between.

🛡️ Four goblin classes — Commander, Shield, Pair, Dual — each with six swappable abilities.

👜 Starter backpack of consumables (buffs, tricks, map tools) — experiment away!

📜 Original narrative: translated journal pages, sketched illustrations, and the first hints about those glowing runes…

🎨 Hand-painted art, moody soundtrack, and just the right amount of dark-fantasy grit.
[hr][/hr]How to play[olist]
Download the demo on our Steam page.

Jump straight into Journal I and guide your goblins to the end of Level 3.

Share screenshots, bugs, or wild strategies in our Discord — we’re listening!
[/olist][hr][/hr]
Why your feedback matters

This is an alpha-content demo; balance numbers, UI polish, and mechanics will continue to evolve. Every suggestion you drop in Steam discussions or Discord helps us sharpen the blades (and maybe lower the knights’ accuracy a tad).
[hr][/hr]
What’s next?

Expanded journals, item synergy, and advanced enemy characters in the full version.

Release date? When the last rune clicks into place — wishlist to get the ping!
[hr][/hr]
Play the demo, wishlist the game, and tell us what secrets you uncover.
See you on the battlefield — and between the lines of the Goblin Journal.

— The Goblin Journal dev team 📕✨
